title: Map draft
status: Fourth draft (D45): bt 7274's layout, with the land painted on and the peoples shown as soft colour that fades and overlaps (D43), not filled regions. Every placement is a lean; the wiki owns the facts and the exact map stays open.

image.note: the legacy sheet `base-legacy.png` (a copy of `legacy-notes/2026-09-22/consolidated-package/Map_-_The_Continent.png`, which the [Source Register](../../wiki/Reference/Source-Register.md) calls a provisional historical concept), with the land painted on by `atlas/tools/terrain_paint.py` from [`terrain.json`](terrain.json) (D45).

continents.name: The Northern Continent
continents.note: By shape: the clover-like land (legacy notes). Northwind holds its north; Highridge's plateau its middle; Greenvale its lower leaf (D40).

continents.name: The Western Continent
continents.note: By shape: the rounded land (legacy notes). Northwind holds its north coast, Ironcrest its uplands, Deepwood most of its lower half, the Sunplains the Long Channel shore; Greenvale keeps a foothold at the Spine's eastern foot (D40).

continents.name: The Eastern Continent
continents.note: By shape: the tapering land (legacy notes). Port at the head of the Inner Sea, Greenvale across the north, the Sunplains along the south coast and the tip.
continents.where: the tapering land along the bottom

regions.name: Northwind
regions.note: The north of both the Northern and Western Continents, with their coasts and islands (bt 7274, D40). It meets Highridge at Icestep Summit and Ironcrest along the Western Continent's north; Greenvale's grain and Deepwood's medicine still reach it only through Icestep or by sea through Port.

regions.name: Ironcrest
regions.note: 'Much of the western upland country': the Western Continent's middle, between Northwind's coast and Deepwood. It reaches the Spine's flank toward Highridge and meets Greenvale's foothold at Stonefield Forge.

regions.name: Deepwood
regions.note: The Western Continent's lower half: forest from the Spine's eastern foot (Twilighthollow) to the far coast, meeting Ironcrest along its upland edge (Darkroot Gulch), Greenvale's foothold and the Sunplains' shore.

regions.name: Highridge Plateau
regions.note: The plateau across the Northern Continent's middle, from Icestep under Northwind's coast down to the Inner Sea, and the Spine itself: the crossroads between Northwind and everyone else. It meets Ironcrest across the Spine's flank, Deepwood at Twilighthollow and Greenvale on the lower leaf and at the Spine's foot (Lowmeet).

regions.name: Greenvale
regions.note: 'The largest major agricultural heartland': the Northern Continent's lower leaf and the Eastern Continent's north, wrapping the Inner Sea's south and west shores round Port, plus a foothold of the western lowlands its rulers 'periodically held' at the Spine's eastern foot, where Stonefield Forge meets Ironcrest.

regions.name: Sunplains
regions.note: The warm south: the Eastern Continent's south coast and tip, and the cities on the Western Continent's shore of the Long Channel, facing them across the water.

regions.name: Port
regions.note: Port's own ground: the south shore of the Inner Sea, at the meeting of every route. It belongs to no kingdom.

waters.name: The Inner Sea
waters.note: Port's bay: a great enclosed sea between the Northern Continent, the Spine and the Eastern Continent, opening to the ocean only through the Narrows. Port stands on its southern shore; Greenvale holds its south and west shores, Highridge its north (lean).

waters.name: The Narrows
waters.note: The strait between the Northern and Eastern Continents: the Inner Sea's only way out to the ocean. Greenvale holds both its shores; Port holds its inner mouth, the Throat (lean).

waters.name: The North Gut
waters.note: The long sound between the Northern and Western Continents, north of the Spine; Northwind holds both sides of its mouth.

waters.name: Footwater
waters.note: The lake at the Spine's southern foot, between Greenvale and Deepwood.

waters.name: The Long Channel
waters.note: The channel from Footwater past the Eastern Continent's tip to the sea, with Sunplains cities on both shores (lean).

waters.name: The Grey Banks
waters.note: The great fishing banks, off Northwind's north coast.

waters.name: The White Current
waters.note: Runs south along Northwind's west coast.

waters.name: The Salted Coast
waters.note: The shore on the sea road between Northwind and the Sunplains (lean: Northwind's west coast and on south); named by the old disputes, and each side means a slightly different stretch.

overrides.note: The Spine, drawn as mountains where the three continents meet; Highridge holds it (lean).

Greenvale's foothold at the Spine's eastern foot: the western lowlands its rulers 'periodically held' from Ironcrest, with the Redlands' wheat and the Chalk Downs (lean). Stonefield Forge stands in it.
Port's ground on the Inner Sea.
Port's ground on Lamp Point, the north side of the Throat: Port holds both sides of its own harbor mouth, so no kingdom holds the gate to the Inner Sea (lean).

leans: **The land and the peoples (D43, D45).** Mountains, hills, forests, farmland, orchards and marsh are painted on the sheet; each people's colour is strongest in its heartland and fades through the edge country, so there are no borders to cross, only country that slowly becomes someone else's. The heartlands follow bt 7274's layout.

**New settlements (D45).** Seven cities (Gullhaven, Mootstead, Hammerford, Fairmarket, Millcombe, Alderhythe, Accord), fourteen villages and two border towns (Ferrowgate, Two Oaks) are new names, sited where the land would put them: harbors, river fords, valley seats, a forest landing. Kingshead, Emberhaven Cross, Vasselin and Twelve Wheels are shown as cities. *Lean:* keep; rename freely.

**More towns and villages (D46).** Sixty-four more, spread so each sits as far from its neighbours as the land allows, with coastal names on the coast and river names on the rivers. *Lean:* keep; move or rename any.

**bt 7274's layout (D40).** Northwind across the north of both continents; Highridge's plateau across the Northern Continent's middle; Greenvale on the lower leaf and round Port; Deepwood the Western Continent's lower half; Ironcrest its uplands. Drawn by bt 7274 on the second draft.

**Port holds both sides of the Throat (D41).** With Greenvale on both shores of the Narrows, the kingdom that feeds Port would also hold its only sea gate, which cuts against Port being 'difficult for one kingdom to seize'. So Port's ground takes Lamp Point, the strait's north shore where it opens into the Inner Sea, with the Old Light on it: Port holds its own harbor mouth, Greenvale the strait's length. *Lean:* keep. The alternative, Greenvale holding the whole gate, would make Greenvale's grip on Port a story fact; that's bt 7274's to add.

**Greenvale's foothold at Stonefield Forge.** The layout separated Ironcrest from Greenvale, but Stonefield Forge is a strongly established border town between them. Greenvale keeps a small piece of the western lowlands at the Spine's eastern foot, which Ironcrest's page says its rulers 'periodically held', and Stonefield Forge stands in it. *Lean:* keep.

**Northwind borders Ironcrest.** Northwind on the Western Continent's north touches Ironcrest by land, so Geography's line that Northwind borders none of its suppliers no longer holds for Ironcrest's metal. Greenvale's grain and Deepwood's medicine still reach Northwind only through Icestep or by sea through Port. Geography now says so.

**Frostbay Way and the sea road.** Frostbay Way, the Northwind–Port border town, becomes Northwind's last harbor on the sea road to Port, on its west coast; the Long Way runs along Northwind's coast to it, and the rest is by ship through the Narrows. *Lean:* keep.

**Northwind's towns moved** to its new coasts: Narrow Sound and Kettle Cove (The Greenvale Man) on the west coast, the Rescue Houses, the Burned Strand and Icefang Fjord on the Western Continent's north shore. The stories only need them coastal and across a headland from each other. Highridge stands between Northwind and Greenvale, so Greenvale still feels far from Kettle Cove.
**Port at the head of the Inner Sea** (D39), unchanged.

**Ironcrest's directions.** Ironcrest's page says its 'eastern and southeastern edges' face Greenvale, Highridge and Deepwood; on this image they face west and south. Read as an old name for a side, like the continents' names. *Lean:* leave the wording.

land_read: bt 7274 chose to read the continents **by shape** (2026-11-09), from the legacy notes: the Northern Continent is "clover-like", the Western "rounded", the Eastern "tapering". The names are old names, not compass directions on this image.
land_after: The three continents meet by land only at the Spine, the mountains drawn at the centre, which fits the legacy notes ("separated by water channels, connected by the Spine") and [Geography](../../wiki/Geography-and-Connections.md#macro-geography), where the continents must meet by land.
